description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present No. 7 Cluain Dara to the market.

This exceptionally spacious four-bedroom semi-detached residence is presented in outstanding condition and occupies a convenient position close to the entrance of one of Knocknacarra’s most popular residential estates.

On arrival, you are greeted by a beautifully maintained brick-paved driveway providing generous off-street parking. A newly fitted, energy-efficient composite front door, with a five-point locking system and glazed side panels, sets the tone for the impressive accommodation within.

The bright and spacious entrance hallway features natural wood flooring and an abundance of floor space. It leads into a beautifully presented living room, complete with a newly fitted marble fireplace and highly efficient inset stove.

Double doors connect the living room to an equally impressive open-plan kitchen and dining area. The fully upgraded kitchen features white Shaker-style units complemented by contrasting wood-finish countertops. A set of of glazed patio doors shower the dining area in natural light whilst providing access to the beautifully appointed rear garden which features a large patio area, manicured lawn with paved walkway, mature planting and a garden shed, creating an inviting setting for outdoor dining, entertaining and family life.

A generously sized utility room, offering further storage, together with a well-presented guest WC, completes the ground-floor accommodation.

Upstairs, a spacious landing leads to four beautifully appointed bedrooms. Each bedroom benefits from built-in storage and an abundance of natural light, while the principal bedroom also features its own private en-suite. An impeccably presented family bathroom completes the accommodation in this outstanding home.

Cluain Dara is a highly regarded residential estate featuring a large central green space and a welcoming, family-friendly setting. Located just off the Western Distributor Road, the property is within easy reach of the extensive amenities available throughout Knocknacarra, including Tesco and Gateway Retail Park.

Several of Galway’s most popular outdoor and recreational amenities are also nearby, including Cappagh Park, Barna Woods, McGrath’s Field and Silverstrand Beach. The area is particularly popular with families due to its selection of nearby primary and secondary schools, while excellent transport links provide convenient access to Galway City and the surrounding areas.

If you are searching for a spacious, impeccably presented and handsomely upgraded family home in one of Knocknacarra’s most sought-after residential locations, then we suggest that you look no further than No. 7 Cluain Dara, as it is certain to meet all your requirements.

Viewing is highly recommended. If this sounds like you, we would be delighted to hear from you and to assist you in any way we can.

Brought to you by Fair Deal Property—your trusted experts in residential property sales.
